answer_1.quote: We present CBART for lexically constrained text generation... Lexically Constrained Text Generation aims to incorporate the given keywords into the generated text.
answer_1.outputs: Generated sentences that contain all given lexical constraints

answer_2.quote: We use BLEU, NIST and METEOR as metrics for the generation quality... we also compute Self-BLEU, distinct bigrams (D-2) and 4-grams (D-4) for diversity.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation... each annotator should compare sentence A with sentence B and decide which one is more fluent or informative.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators compare two sentences and judge which is more fluent or more informative; ties allowed.
